oracle-l5r-10357.note: Witness the Untold (Spell, Torn Asunder, issue #674): "Reaction: After your Ring enters play, bow this card: Look at the top three cards of your Dynasty or Fate deck. Put them back in any order." The look and reorder exist (LookSpec, It Was a Cat's shape: either deck, three cards, reorder only), but nothing narrates a Ring entering play: every Ring is put into play by its own recruit case (RingEnteredByOwnText) and no Reaction trigger "after your Ring enters play" exists for another card to listen to (the Ring-entering gap the TRIG-AFTER category names). Needs a new reaction trigger fired from every Ring's entry, which is shared-interface work.
